name: Medicine Ball Squat Throw to Wall
steps: Face a wall suitable for throwing and cup a soft medicine ball at your chest with both hands.
Squat with your heels grounded, keeping the ball close beneath your chin.
Drive out of the squat and extend your arms to send the ball up toward a target on the wall.
Receive the descending ball at chest height and bend your knees to cushion it into the next squat.
tips: Use your legs to give the ball height before finishing the throw with your arms.
Step back and let a missed catch fall clear rather than reaching underneath it.
